Website Maintenance Mistakes to Avoid: A Comprehensive Guide

# Website Maintenance Mistakes to Avoid: A Comprehensive Guide in 2023

### Mohammad Ashraful Islam

29 December 2022

[ Linkedin __](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashraful-islam-78aa7a1a0/) [ Facebook __](https://www.facebook.com/AR.Ashraf.1936) [ Twitter __](https://twitter.com/ar_ashraf__)

Website Maintenance is essential for the success of any business, but it's not always easy to get it right. There are many pitfalls and mistakes that can be made, which can lead to costly and time-consuming issues. In this comprehensive guide, we'll go over some of the most common website maintenance mistakes to avoid, specifically for [**WordPress**](https://wordpress.org/) websites.

## 1\. Working live with no backup

One of the biggest mistakes businesses make is working on their website without making a proper backup first. If something goes wrong during the process, you won't be able to restore your website to its previous state without a backup. This can be especially problematic if you hire a professional to redesign your website without making a backup of the old one. It's also important to remember to regularly **[back up](https://www.hostinger.com/tutorials/backup-wordpress?ppc_campaign=google_search_generic_hosting_all&bidkw=defaultkeyword&lo=1001441&gclid=CjwKCAiA76-dBhByEiwAA0_s9afp_5cOGtJ2mLNMoYfx4swFg3aH8vv_DDhEyheArA_5atetLCx3sxoClUkQAvD_BwE) **your website in case of a security breach.

## 2\. Neglecting website security

Website security is essential to protect your business and customers' sensitive information from cyberattacks. It's important to regularly update passwords, install [**security plugins**](https://www.elegantthemes.com/blog/wordpress/best-wordpress-security-plugins?utm_source=Blog&utm_medium=Manual%20WordPress%20Targets&utm_campaign=Google%20Search&retargeting=off&gclid=CjwKCAiA76-dBhByEiwAA0_s9YlFoDDXj9tU5gIDnCseaxwHXXLZX2gyXADBEDfd7V4o9AP52QjEaRoCjS0QAvD_BwE), and stay up to date on the latest security best practices in order to keep your website safe.

## 3\. Skimping on hosting

While it may be tempting to choose the cheapest hosting option available, this can be a costly mistake in the long run. Cheap hosting often comes with limited resources, slow loading times, and poor uptime, all of which can negatively impact your website's performance and user experience. It's worth investing in a [**quality hosting provider**](https://www.bluehost.com/) that can provide reliable, fast, and secure hosting for your website.

## 4\. Overlooking mobile optimization

With more and more users accessing the internet via mobile devices, it's crucial to ensure that your website is optimized for mobile. Failing to optimize your website for mobile can lead to a poor user experience, low search engine rankings, and a decrease in traffic. Make sure to test your website on various mobile devices and implement responsive design techniques to ensure that it looks and functions well on all devices.

## 5\. Neglecting website performance

Website performance is an important factor in user experience and search engine rankings. If your website is slow to load or has technical issues, visitors will be less likely to stick around. It's important to regularly check your [**website 's performance**](https://webflow.com/blog/website-performance-test-tools) and address any issues that may be causing slow loading times or other technical problems. This can include optimizing images, minifying code, and using caching plugins to improve the speed and efficiency of your website.

## 6\. Ignoring website updates

Keeping your WordPress website up to date is essential for security and performance. Neglecting to update the core software, themes, and plugins can leave your website vulnerable to security breaches and technical issues. Make sure to regularly check for updates and install them in a timely manner to ensure that your website is running smoothly.

## 7\. Not having a website maintenance plan

A common mistake that businesses make is not having a clear plan for website maintenance. This can lead to a lack of consistency in website updates and maintenance tasks, which can result in problems down the line. It's important to establish a regular schedule for website maintenance and to stick to it in order to keep your website running smoothly.

## 8\. Not testing before making changes

Before making any changes to your website, it's important to test them thoroughly to ensure that they won't cause any issues. This includes testing new plugins, themes, and updates on a staging site before implementing them on the live website. Failing to test changes can lead to broken functionality, security vulnerabilities, and other problems that can be difficult to fix.

## 9\. Not monitoring website analytics

Monitoring your website's analytics is an important part of website maintenance. By keeping track of metrics such as traffic, conversion rates, and user behavior, you can identify areas for improvement and make informed decisions about your website's content and design. Neglecting to monitor your [**website 's analytics**](https://www.smartlook.com/blog/free-website-analytics-tools/) can lead to a lack of insight into how your website is performing and what changes may be necessary to improve it.

## 10\. Not having a website maintenance budget

Website maintenance can be a costly endeavor, and it's important to allocate a budget for it in order to ensure that your website stays up to date and functioning properly. Neglecting to budget for website maintenance can result in unexpected expenses and delays in addressing issues that arise. Make sure to set aside a [**budget for website maintenance**](https://devs-core.com/maintenance/) and use it wisely to ensure that your website stays in top condition.

In summary, avoiding these common website maintenance mistakes is crucial for the success of your business website. Proper website maintenance is essential for security, performance, user experience, and search engine rankings. By following best practices and setting aside a budget for maintenance, you can ensure that your website stays in top condition and continues to serve your business needs effectively.

Tags: [maintenance guide](https://devs-core.com/tag/maintenance-guide/), [maintenance mistakes](https://devs-core.com/tag/maintenance-mistakes/), [website maintenance](https://devs-core.com/tag/website-maintenance/), [wordpress maintenance](https://devs-core.com/tag/wordpress-maintenance/)

Is ChatGPT Right for Your Business? Understanding the Advantages and Dangers of AI Chatbots

# Is ChatGPT Right for Your Business? Understanding the Advantages and Dangers of AI Chatbots

### Mohammad Ashraful Islam

28 December 2022

[ Linkedin __](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashraful-islam-78aa7a1a0/) [ Facebook __](https://www.facebook.com/AR.Ashraf.1936) [ Twitter __](https://twitter.com/ar_ashraf__)

"**AI chatbot helps businesses improve customer service** " - Forbes, 2022.

As businesses look for ways to improve customer service and streamline communication, many are turning to artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots like **ChatGPT**. Developed by OpenAI, ChatGPT is a natural language processing (NLP) model that can generate human-like text in real-time and continue a conversation based on previous input. While ChatGPT can be a valuable tool for businesses, it's important to consider both the advantages and dangers of using this technology.

## Advantages of ChatGPT

  1. **Natural and intuitive communication.**
  2. **Ability to learn and improve.**



One of the major advantages of ChatGPT is its ability to communicate with users in a natural and intuitive way. It can generate responses that are appropriate and relevant to the conversation, making it a valuable tool for customer service and other applications where human-like communication is important. In fact, ChatGPT has been used by businesses in a variety of industries to improve customer service, including retail, banking, and travel.

Another advantage of ChatGPT is its ability to learn and improve over time. As it receives more input, it can learn to generate more accurate and relevant responses. This makes it a useful tool for tasks that require a high level of accuracy, such as language translation or content creation. Businesses in industries such as technology and media have leveraged ChatGPT's ability to generate accurate and relevant content to improve their marketing efforts.

## Dangers of ChatGPT

  1. **Difficult to differentiate from human responses.**
  2. **Potential for malicious use.**



However, there are also dangers to using ChatGPT. One concern is that it can be difficult to differentiate between responses generated by ChatGPT and those written by a human. This can be especially problematic in cases where the model is used to create content for social media or other platforms, as it can lead to the spread of misinformation.

Another danger is the potential for ChatGPT to be used for malicious purposes. It could be used to generate spam or phishing emails, or to spread propaganda or other harmful content. It's important for users of ChatGPT to be aware of these dangers and take appropriate precautions to prevent abuse.

Overall, ChatGPT is a powerful tool that can have many beneficial applications for businesses. However, it's important to be aware of the potential dangers and take steps to minimize them. By using ChatGPT responsibly, businesses can leverage its capabilities to improve communication and create valuable content.

Tags: [Business](https://devs-core.com/tag/business/), [chatbot](https://devs-core.com/tag/chatbot/), [chatgpt](https://devs-core.com/tag/chatgpt/), [dangers of AI](https://devs-core.com/tag/dangers-of-ai/)

Quote on dedication towards customers - CEO Devs Core

# How Much Dedication Should My Customer Get From Me?

### Mohammad Ashraful Islam

7 August 2022

[ Linkedin __](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashraful-islam-78aa7a1a0/) [ Facebook __](https://www.facebook.com/AR.Ashraf.1936) [ Twitter __](https://twitter.com/ar_ashraf__)

A study carried out by Bain & Company found that a 5% increase in customer retention can increase business profits by 25% — 125%. To keep your customers, you need to understand their needs. Business is about people, the more you know people, the more you prosper.

Being the founder of a Software Company — [ _Devs Core_](https://devs-core.com/) I got the chance to meet lots of people and build relationships. As this is a technological era, businesses of all sectors need software support, especially cloud-based ones.

But today we are talking about CUSTOMERS. Let’s start with one of my customers…

I once got the opportunity to work with a leading paper mill industry in Bangladesh for a Web Development Project. The client wanted to expand in foreign markets and attract investors. Like our usual policy, we offered the client a total package — UI Design, Front-end Development, Back-end Development, Domain, Hosting, Database Design, Content Writing, and SEO for the project. After the contract was signed, our team started the work.

As this was a project focusing on the Paper Mill Industry, our team started their research on the industry. At first, we learned how this industry works and a few things about the manufacturing process. Then our team went to the mill and stayed there the whole day (It was outside town and the team had a long trip that day). The reason was to understand our client better. We talked with the managers, manufacturers, laborers and many more. This helped us to get an actual image of our client’s products and their working procedures(I still remember how they managed a 100% renewable manufacturing process in their mill). It was a day full of notes, data, stories of successes and stories of dreams.

And then we started our development phases. After 1 month long trial and error our client was happy with our development.

During the development process, our only intention was to solve my client’s investor problem. And we succeeded to represent their brand perfectly through our web development project. In the end, the client was talking with a foreign investor and was pretty happy! We still talk occasionally and share our achievements and pains.

Through our journey, we have been building such relationships with our clients. Our customers deserve more dedication from us and we are trying to make our business all about them.

Tags: [Business](https://devs-core.com/tag/business/), [Customer](https://devs-core.com/tag/customer/), [dedication](https://devs-core.com/tag/dedication/), [devs core](https://devs-core.com/tag/devs-core/)

# Top 6 Software Companies in Mohakhali DOHS, Dhaka

Software Companies help business sectors to become technologically solvent. That saves time and costs. Here is a list of Professional Software Companies who are based in Mohakhali DOHS, Dhaka, Bangladesh:

**1\. Devs Core**

**2\. Spark IT**

**3\. Invento**

**4\. Revinr**

**5\. Wb-Soft**

**6\. CloudlyIO**

### Mohammad Ashraful Islam

10 April 2022

[ Linkedin __](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashraful-islam-78aa7a1a0/) [ Facebook __](https://www.facebook.com/AR.Ashraf.1936) [ Twitter __](https://twitter.com/ar_ashraf__)

## [1\. Devs Core](https://devs-core.com/)

Devs Core is a software development company that provides enterprise software and effective solutions for managing business operations and customer relations according to your specific business needs. We believe in building trust and strong relationships with our clients as a collaborative approach delivers the best results. We are the best software company in Bangladesh, affording the best software maintenance.

## [2\. Spark IT](http://www.sparkitbd.com/)

SPARK IT is one of the largest IT service provider in Bangladesh.Since 2008, SPARK IT has connected technology solution providers with users nationwide, identifying markets and technologies that shape the IT industry. For SPARK, its customers are not only the most important stakeholders; rather they are regarded as the most valued partners as well. And we aim to establish SPARK IT as the leading company and reach its services nation and worldwide. From the beginning SPARK IT was promised to keep a potential role on technological advancement. We've been in this business for over 10 years, and now we have 17 team members working day and night to serve our Customers demand.

## [3\. Invento](http://invento.com.bd/)

We are Invento Software Limited, previously known as Invento Bangladesh based in Dhaka Bangladesh. We have started our journey in 2014 into a small room with only 3 people but with big dreams to achieve. Initial focus was building web and mobile applications. Within a year we have introduced retail and enterprise software products in market. In last 6 years our company has shown continuous growth & served more than 100 happy clients locally and globally.

Our digital marketing team helped launching international brands in Dhaka and created vivid brand presence in digital space for many national and international brands.

## [4\. Revinr](http://www.revinr.com/)

We are a creative agency dedicated to turn your ideas into reality exactly the way you want them. We guarantee completion of clients’ projects in minimal time with no compromises in the creative quality of our work. revinr aspires to deliver beautiful and interactive experiences complemented by functionality. We specialise on a variety of platforms and technologies, ranging from responsive web development, database infrastructure development and implementation, mobile applications design and development to software design and development.

## [5\. Wb-Soft](http://wbsoftwares.com/)

WB Softwares Is Your IT Solution Partner . WBSoftwares Is A Recognised Servicenow Sales Service And Training Leader .As Bangladesh Is A Developing Country We Are Creating The Environment Such That It Can Grow More.  
This Company Can Ensure You Full Support. WB Softwares Employees Have Diligently Worked For Years. In These Past Years Our Main Concern Was Customers Satisfaction And Will Work For Securing Its Reputation As A Well Known Company In Bangladesh.

## [6\. CloudlyIO](https://cloudly.io/)

Cloudly is the cloud native services company, leading the most complex technology projects in the world. We leverage the innovative capabilities of the cloud to help customers build new revenue streams, increase efficiency, and deliver incredible experiences. As a Consulting Partner, our unmatched expertise with AWS means we’ve been there, done that, and bought the t-shirt. We focus on results (not PowerPoints) as we help our customers uncover new possibilities to put them on the leading edge of innovation in their industry.

Different SaaS Worth Integrating for Business

# Different SaaS Worth Integrating for Business

**1\. What is SaaS?**

**2\. SaaS Scenarios Connected With Business Processes.**

**3.** **What is SaaS Integration?**

**4\. Taking the integrated SaaS business model route increases for solid reasons.**

**5\. Examples of Software as a Service and SaaS integration.**

**6\. Advantages of SaaS Integration.**

**7\. Future of SaaS Integration.**

### Mohammad Ashraful Islam

29 March 2022

[ Linkedin __](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashraful-islam-78aa7a1a0/) [ Facebook __](https://www.facebook.com/AR.Ashraf.1936) [ Twitter __](https://twitter.com/ar_ashraf__)

**Software as a service provider (SaaS)** is the most common way to deliver applications remotely to users for business over the internet. These are easily accessible with an internet connection and a browser. It manages **[cloud application software](https://comparecamp.com/cloud-based-software/)** , serves automatic software updates, and makes software available to its customers via the internet on a pay-as-you-go basis. Nowadays, Integrated SaaS is the best infrastructure to make a business successful.

Have you ever felt the integration of SaaS products allows businesses to drive better value? Do you want to know whether this is useful for your business or not? For diving into the SaaS world, go through the blog.

## SaaS Scenarios Connected With Business Processes

As Startups and small businesses don't have time expertise to build their application, they find SaaS handy. Larger companies also find SaaS valuable technology for short-term processes. When dealing with applications that need web and mobile access, SaaS is beneficial for companies. Businesses want a SaaS solution that supports procure-to-pay or order-to-cash in the cloud without costly integrations and structural management.

## What is SaaS Integration?

SaaS Integration means integrating different SaaS products to generate a workflow or business operation. For example, when you add your **[CRM](https://www.revechat.com/blog/customer-relationship-management-examples/)** (Customer Relationship Management, a category of integrated data-driven software solutions) with your email marketing tool, you have combined two SaaS products to facilitate a flexible flow of information across the channels. SaaS integration joins a [**SaaS-based**](https://citrusbug.com/blog/saas-application-example) application with another cloud-based app or software by integrating an application programming interface (**API**). Once this addition is complete, both applications can quickly demand and share data. 

## Taking the integrated SaaS business model route increases for solid reasons

The Integrated SaaS business model serves the following things. It restricts security compliance and governance issues, saves valuable time and resources, and boosts employee engagement and productivity. It also minimizes errors and delays. When it comes to centralizing data management, SaaS integration makes it more easily accessible. It is indispensable for businesses to give customers a range of protocols, connectors, options, and data formats to get a solution. And that's what makes SaaS integration mandatory. 

## Examples of Software as a Service and SaaS integration

Email, calendaring, Microsoft [**office 365**](https://techmusa.com/o365-saas-solution/) , [**Dropbox**](https://www.dropbox.com/), [**Google G Suite**](https://workspace.google.com/), [**Salesforce**](https://www.salesforce.com/), [**Zoom**](https://zoom.us/), and other office tools are used in the cloud market. Integration-led automation platforms are not only functions as an iPaas and ETL tool. For example, Google workspace Suites is made of simple saas integration. Google owns various applications: **Gmail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Drive**. Google has joined them to make it easy to move information between the applications while doing work. Since Google has all the applications, they create the platform to transfer data quickly. Integrated SaaS makes it so that applications from different SaaS vendors can talk to each other.

## Advantages of SaaS Integration

Users can access information easily stored in the cloud through an internet browser, and for that, no installation, equipment updates, and licensing management are needed. The cost of hardware is zero. As data is only saved in the cloud, the service providers can invest heavily in security technology and expertise. It will mobilize your workforce and business efficiently. Intelligent workflows will bring down operational costs.

## Future of SaaS Integration

**[SaaS companies](https://www.toolbox.com/tech/cloud/articles/top-10-saas-companies/)** are overgrowing and more efficient than ever before. Moreover, as more have embraced offering rich integrations with other platforms, there are more platforms to integrate nowadays, making the whole SaaS thing more alluring to customers. As a result, SaaS companies have been growing explosively, and it has meant more contribution and access to the best solutions that are more cost-effective. More competitors might be perceived as bad for the SaaS companies themselves. But perhaps it has derived into many marketing and business opportunities instead.

**Devs Core** has been selected among the **Top[eCommerce App Development Companies](https://www.designrush.com/agency/mobile-app-design-development/ecommerce) **by Designrush.

Check out our other articles - [**Blog Page**](https://devs-core.com/blog-devs-core/)

Data-Driven Marketing

# DATA-DRIVEN MARKETING: MORE EFFICIENT MEDIA BUYING BY TARGETING THE RIGHT CUSTOMER in 2022

### Mohammad Ashraful Islam

29 March 2022

[ Linkedin __](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashraful-islam-78aa7a1a0/) [ Facebook __](https://www.facebook.com/AR.Ashraf.1936) [ Twitter __](https://twitter.com/ar_ashraf__)

Who knew within 150 years, humans would have generated more data than the total number of atoms in the whole world? Using data in a good way can boundlessly benefit the realm of business and marketing. Do you want to discover how **Data-Driven Marketing** leads us to reach out to customers in the best possible ways? Here are the answers.

Data-driven marketing is collecting and using the information to drive your marketing decisions. It refers to marketing strategies built on insights that came from data analysis. These are managed through the interaction and engagement of customers, and we use these to make predictions and optimize future behaviors. It serves the intent of reaching a desired set of audience. **[Data-driven marketing](https://www.demandjump.com/blog/what-is-data-driven-marketing)** gives the answers like who, when, where, what message and makes those answers actionable.

## The Importance of Data-Driven Marketing: The Marketing strategies for the highest possible ROI

For More efficient media buying, **[targeting the right customers](https://informi.co.uk/marketing-and-sales/how-do-i-target-right-customers)** , messaging audiences with relevant messages, Data-driven marketing is an indispensable business need today. Retargeting, dynamic advertising, optimized paid search, and targeted email companies help you properly build relationships with the right audiences. In addition, data-driven marketers use customer data to predict their needs and desires. Such intuition helps develop personalized marketing planning for the highest possible return on investment (ROI).

## How data-driven marketing affects business performance, specifically.

#### Introduction of many ideas of marketing has been produced. It also leads to the introduction of many software like **[CRM](https://www.revechat.com/blog/customer-relationship-management-examples/)** (Customer relation management). It helps marketers find who individual customers are, like the name and contact information. It enables direct mailing and, therefore, direct marketing campaigns. Customers might receive different messages based on the marketer's ideas on the segments if it were a good fit and what the customers care about. Digital data-driven marketing gave birth to new category marketing automation software. Today, marketers spend over 6 billion a year on data-driven targeting solutions like data management platforms and demand-side platforms. But most marketing teams are not yet entirely making their data active. They have so far been mostly limited to optimizing media with their data.

## Data-Driven Marketing: The ability to build stronger connections with potential customers

First, setting a well-defined goal is necessary. And for that, a target audience is needed to determine. After lining up and integrating the correct data, you have to choose the marketing channels where you will interact. You can collect data from primary sources or third-party information providers. Such things provide advantages like gathering customer information and identifying conditions in the business or finding additional room for improvement. You need to analyze and discover. These data will be activated and then used for starting marketing strategies. This entire process goes through investigation, optimization, and evaluation. Then all the findings and gathered data are then implemented for processing **[data-driven](https://www.educba.com/data-driven-marketing-strategy/)** marketing strategies. 

## How to Approach Data-Driven Marketing?

Integrating new tools and technologies into your commerce can be overwhelming at a time by creating an automated practice. First, you have to ensure collaboration across teams. Marketers must be certain information is being shared across departments and units. Another important thing is monitoring industry changes and keeping a close eye on the competition so that you can either follow suit or learn from their mistakes like every other area in the industry. Data-driven marketing is constantly changing, so staying up-to-date on the latest trends will only help you with continuous brand strategy measurements.

## Benefits of Data-Driven Marketing

By marketing campaigns, you can target only the best people and audience. Messaging must be consistent. You can divide your audience into different sections. Before you do anything, please know who your customers are. Then Your first step is to create buzz. You can also improve your product development by **[personalized marketing](https://blogs.constantcontact.com/why-personalization-for-marketing/)** is a great way to increase sales.

## Challenges Faced in Data-Driven Marketing

The significant challenges faced in data-driven marketing, like the most common struggle they have arrived at due to the complicated nature of the job and analytics tools required. It is challenging to attract the correct staff. It specializes in predictive analysis of audience amplification. Learning more about data-driven or becoming a data scientist may benefit you and your team. The success of data-driven marketing is mainly dependent on having high-quality and **[integrated data](https://whatagraph.com/blog/articles/data-integration-examples)** , which is not easy to ask infrequently. Some companies continue to make mistakes even though they collect different data sources to run their operations. 

The reason why we see widespread adoption of AI by major brands is now moving ahead of the following critical stage of the future of data-driven marketing in Data management platforms. **64%** of marketing executives "**strongly agree** " that data-driven marketing is crucial in the economy. **49%** of marketers feel "**significant pressure** " to increase data's role in their current strategy, whereas **87%** of marketers consider data their organization's most underutilized asset. (**[References](https://www.invespcro.com/blog/data-driven-marketing/)**) .Although many marketers only see the MPS as helpful in serving fundamental issues. The next critical stage for data-driven marketing is to find a balance between personalization and privacy. Today's consumers increasingly empower technology, and by government privacy regulations, it's the first order of business for branch information. Without this permission, you cannot create a personalized customer experience. 

## Conclusion

The data is increasing exponentially. We have been collecting vast amounts of data and will collect it in the future, creating a basic **[data marketing](https://www.accudata.com/blog/data-marketing/)** sense of all. Data-driven Marketing can change the destinies of entrepreneurs by a complete three hundred and sixty degrees. So, what are your thoughts about the future of data-driven marketing?

# Shobdle | শব্দল - All You Need to Know About Wordle's Bengali Cousin

### Mohammad Ashraful Islam

28 February 2022

[ Linkedin __](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashraful-islam-78aa7a1a0/) [ Facebook __](https://www.facebook.com/AR.Ashraf.1936) [ Twitter __](https://twitter.com/ar_ashraf__)

## Shobdle was developed to honor International Mother Language Day.

[**শব্দল**](https://shobdle.devs-core.com/) - চার বর্ণে লিখে ফেলো তোমার দিনলিপি, বন্ধুরা আবিষ্কার করবে তোমার আজকের শব্দল! [**Shobdle**](https://shobdle.devs-core.com/) is the Bengali cousin of Wordle, but is more interesting to play. Because, at Shobdle, you get to set your own word of the day and your friends try to guess the word in 7 chances. [**Devs Core**](https://devs-core.com/) has developed this amazing word game to honor International Mother Language Day.

## How do you play Shobdle?

Anyone can set his/her Shobdle (Word of his/her Day) at Shobdle's Page - **[Click Here](https://shobdle.devs-core.com/)**! This word will be live for the day and you can share your Shobdle game link with your friends and family for them to find out your word.

Clicking on anyone's shobdle game link, you will be prompted to shobdle starting page where you will have to start the game by simply entering your name. (Your friend needs to know that you found his/her shobdle, right?)

**Shobdle** gives you 7 chances to guess the Bengali word, the word of the day. The word has to be a word that fits in 4 blocks. There are 5 different colors to let you know how close your guess is. After each try, the blocks change color to either **green** (correct letter/consonant cluster/diacritics combo, correct block), **yellow** (correct letter/consonant cluster/diacritics combo, incorrect block), **blue** (some part of the letter/consonant cluster/diacritics combo is incorrect, correct block), **pink** (some part of the letter/consonant cluster/diacritics combo is incorrect, incorrect block), or **black** (not in the word). Once successfully completed, you can share the result as an image in your social media to let your friend know that you cracked his/her shobdle. Your name will be in the leaderboard in that result page with your ranking. Each day this ranking will be updated with that day's play history. 

Players select the letters of the Bengali alphabet from the virtual keyboard and when they are done with all 4 tiles press Enter. The game checks if the word matches with the word of the day or not. If you can match the word within those 7 chances then you win.

This game can be played by people of all ages. Even a child can play this game. There is no age restriction. So, if a person can read and write Bengali, she/he can play this game, though you should keep it in mind that guessing Bengali words can be quite challenging.

## Where to play Shobdle?

**Shobdle** is only accessible online. To play this game you need to visit -   
[**https://shobdle.devs-core.com/**](https://shobdle.devs-core.com/)

Just go to the above link every day to create your Shobdle and share it with your friends and family. Let's see if they can figure out what's going on in your mind today with a Bengali word. Best of luck!

## Do you need to pay anything to play Shobdle?

No, **it is totally free**. This game was not published for any monetization purpose. The sole purpose of publishing this game was to bring joy to the people speaking the Bengali language all over the world. And this will remain so. Shobdle will help people enrich their Bengali vocabulary everyday.

## Who developed Shobdle?

**Shobdle is owned and developed by Devs Core - A software company in Bangladesh**. 

## Want to know more about Shobdle?

**Shobdle** got featured in various news portals. **_[Please read this news featured on India Today to know more about Shobdle](https://www.indiatoday.in/trending-news/story/did-you-know-about-the-bengali-version-of-wordle-it-s-called-shobdle-1919355-2022-03-01). _**

## FROM FIRST CALL TO DEPLOYMENT

# UI/UX Design Process

### 1

## Discovery

  * Design Brief 
  * Market Research 
  * Mapping 



We start by understanding your product vision, business goals, audience, and user challenges — aligning design with what truly matters.

We gather insight through stakeholder interviews, competitor analysis, and startup benchmarking — feeding the process with context, not guesswork.

We outline the user’s ideal flow from entry to action — removing friction, prioritizing clarity, and focusing on outcomes that drive success.

### 1

## Discovery

Design Brief

We start by understanding your product vision, business goals, audience, and user challenges — aligning design with what truly matters.

Market Research

We gather insight through stakeholder interviews, competitor analysis, and startup benchmarking — feeding the process with context, not guesswork.

Mapping

We outline the user’s ideal flow from entry to action — removing friction, prioritizing clarity, and focusing on outcomes that drive success.

### 2

## UX Strategy

  * Low-Fidelity Wireframes 
  * Architecture 
  * UX Flows 



We sketch and structure layouts based on core functionality, hierarchy, and content blocks — no distractions, just purpose.

We define how users navigate your product — organizing content, flows, and structure for maximum discoverability and ease of use.

Click-through prototypes demonstrate user paths, validating logic and flow before investing in visuals.

### 2

## UX Strategy

Low-Fidelity Wireframes

We sketch and structure layouts based on core functionality, hierarchy, and content blocks — no distractions, just purpose.

Architecture

We define how users navigate your product — organizing content, flows, and structure for maximum discoverability and ease of use.

UX Flows

Click-through prototypes demonstrate user paths, validating logic and flow before investing in visuals.

### 3

## UI Design

  * High-Fidelity Mockups 
  * Responsive 
  * Prototypes 



We design pixel-perfect screens for all device types — reflecting your brand, values, and product personality with clarity and consistency.

We create modular designs for desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoints — ready for developers to plug into any frontend stack.

Clickable, animated prototypes in Figma or Framer that simulate the real product — perfect for stakeholder review or investor presentations.

### 3

## UI Design

High-Fidelity Mockups

We design pixel-perfect screens for all device types — reflecting your brand, values, and product personality with clarity and consistency.

Responsive

We create modular designs for desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoints — ready for developers to plug into any frontend stack.

Prototypes

Clickable, animated prototypes in Figma or Framer that simulate the real product — perfect for stakeholder review or investor presentations.

### 4

## Handoff

  * Handoff 
  * Collaboration 
  * Design Iteration 



Clean Figma files, annotated components, spacing tokens, fonts, and assets — ready for export and development.

We work closely with your developers to ensure design implementation is true to vision — supporting with revisions, specs, and tweaks.

Need versioning or post-launch improvements? We stay on for iteration, A/B testing, and continued UX optimization.

# FAQ?

# Most Asked Questions About Us

  * What makes Devs Core different from other software development companies?

Devs Core stands out due to our commitment to sustainable, tailor-made software solutions, 100% source code handover, punctuality in meeting deadlines, and strong partnerships with tech giants like Google, Microsoft, AWS, and Nvidia.

  * How does Devs Core ensure the sustainability of its software solutions?

We focus on building adaptable, efficient, and future-proof software that grows with your business, leveraging the latest technologies and proper documentations to ensure longevity and sustainability.

  * Can Devs Core handle the entire software development lifecycle?

Yes, we manage the full lifecycle of software development, from initial understanding and planning through development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.

  * What industries does Devs Core specialize in?

We cater to a wide range of industries, including E-Commerce, Institution, Recycling, Human Resources, Finance, Healthcare, Real Estate, AI integrations, IoT, and FinTech.

  * What are the benefits of custom software for startups?

Custom software gives startups complete flexibility to build tools that match their exact workflows. Unlike off-the-shelf platforms, it scales with your growth, integrates with your systems, and eliminates licensing restrictions. It also ensures long-term cost-efficiency and competitive advantage.

  * Does Devs Core offer custom software solutions for startups and small businesses?

Absolutely, we provide custom software solutions tailored to the unique needs of startups and small businesses, helping them scale and automate their operations effectively. However, we prefer working with companies that has been in the business for at least 3 years.

  * How does Devs Core ensure the quality and reliability of its software products?

Our quality assurance process involves rigorous testing, adherence to best practices, and leveraging our partnerships with global tech giants to ensure the highest standards of quality and reliability.

  * Can you integrate AI/LLMs into existing platforms?

Yes. We specialize in embedding AI and LLM-based tools into your current applications. Whether it's automating customer support, personalizing user journeys, or enabling intelligent data processing, we ensure smooth, secure integration with your existing stack.

  * What does 100% source code ownership mean?

It means you fully own all the code we write for your project—no hidden dependencies, no recurring fees, and no vendor lock-in. You get full control over your software, with the freedom to scale or modify it as your business grows.

  * What post-deployment support does Devs Core offer?

We offer comprehensive maintenance and support services post-deployment to ensure the smooth operation of the software, including updates, bug fixes, and scalability support. 

Please check out our Maintenance Packages - https://devs-core.com/maintenance/

  * How do I get started with Devs Core?

Simply reach out through our contact form or schedule a consultation. We’ll listen to your vision, assess your needs, and prepare a tailored roadmap—from discovery to launch.

# AI Agent Expertise

## Sales & Support

LLM-powered agents that respond to queries, pre-qualify leads, and provide instant support — embedded in your product or marketing site.

## Internal Workflow

Automate repetitive admin and operational tasks with AI agents connected to your tools — Slack, CRMs, Google Sheets, Notion, and more.

## Knowledge-Based Agents

## Onboarding & Education

Personalized AI walkthroughs for users inside your app — from onboarding and activation to ongoing engagement and product education.

## Autonomous Task

Multi-step agents that plan, adapt, and execute — ideal for startups exploring agentic workflows, decision trees, and prompt chaining.

## RAG Agents

Need your AI agent to answer based on PDFs, docs, or Notion pages? We build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) agents that combine LLMs with your custom data — giving users trustworthy, document-backed responses.

Multi-step agents that plan, adapt, and execute — ideal for startups exploring agentic workflows, decision trees, and prompt chaining.

## RAG Agents

Need your AI agent to answer based on PDFs, docs, or Notion pages? We build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) agents that combine LLMs with your custom data — giving users trustworthy, document-backed responses.

## FROM FIRST CALL TO DEPLOYMENT

# AI Agent Development Process

### 1

## Discovery

  * Vision Brief 
  * LLM Strategy 
  * Roadmap 



We begin with a discovery session and brief focused on your core use case, startup roadmap, user base, and target workflows.

We help you select the right LLM platform (OpenAI, Azure, Claude, Llama2) and determine whether you need prompt-based agents or agentic chains.

From triggers and expected responses to fallbacks and actions, we map out the agent’s logic and architecture with startup-grade clarity.

### 1

## Discovery

Vision Brief

We begin with a discovery session and brief focused on your core use case, startup roadmap, user base, and target workflows.

LLM Strategy

We help you select the right LLM platform (OpenAI, Azure, Claude, Llama2) and determine whether you need prompt-based agents or agentic chains.

Roadmap

From triggers and expected responses to fallbacks and actions, we map out the agent’s logic and architecture with startup-grade clarity.

### 2

## Prompt Design

  * Prompt Engineering 
  * Contextual Awareness 
  * Safety 



We write and test base prompts, system instructions, tone control, and role definitions for predictable, accurate agent behavior.

For smart responses, we connect the agent to vector databases (RAG) or internal APIs so it can retrieve, summarize, and respond dynamically.

We add moderation, safety prompts, and behavioral boundaries to keep responses appropriate and within scope.

### 2

Prompt Engineering

Contextual Awareness

Safety

  * Frontend 
  * Integration 
  * Optimization 



Need a branded chat interface or app widget? We design and develop agent UIs that feel intuitive and native to your product.

We connect your agent to real tools — from CRMs and analytics platforms to ticketing systems and scheduling APIs.

For advanced use cases, we build agents that can plan and self-evaluate — with memory, task queueing, and modular logic.

# FAQ?

# Most Asked Questions About Us

  * What makes Devs Core different from other software development companies?

Devs Core stands out due to our commitment to sustainable, tailor-made software solutions, 100% source code handover, punctuality in meeting deadlines, and strong partnerships with tech giants like Google, Microsoft, AWS, and Nvidia.

  * How does Devs Core ensure the sustainability of its software solutions?

We focus on building adaptable, efficient, and future-proof software that grows with your business, leveraging the latest technologies and proper documentations to ensure longevity and sustainability.

  * Can Devs Core handle the entire software development lifecycle?

Yes, we manage the full lifecycle of software development, from initial understanding and planning through development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.

  * What industries does Devs Core specialize in?

We cater to a wide range of industries, including E-Commerce, Institution, Recycling, Human Resources, Finance, Healthcare, Real Estate, AI integrations, IoT, and FinTech.

  * What are the benefits of custom software for startups?

Custom software gives startups complete flexibility to build tools that match their exact workflows. Unlike off-the-shelf platforms, it scales with your growth, integrates with your systems, and eliminates licensing restrictions. It also ensures long-term cost-efficiency and competitive advantage.

  * Does Devs Core offer custom software solutions for startups and small businesses?

Absolutely, we provide custom software solutions tailored to the unique needs of startups and small businesses, helping them scale and automate their operations effectively. However, we prefer working with companies that has been in the business for at least 3 years.

  * How does Devs Core ensure the quality and reliability of its software products?

Our quality assurance process involves rigorous testing, adherence to best practices, and leveraging our partnerships with global tech giants to ensure the highest standards of quality and reliability.

  * Can you integrate AI/LLMs into existing platforms?

Yes. We specialize in embedding AI and LLM-based tools into your current applications. Whether it's automating customer support, personalizing user journeys, or enabling intelligent data processing, we ensure smooth, secure integration with your existing stack.

  * What does 100% source code ownership mean?

It means you fully own all the code we write for your project—no hidden dependencies, no recurring fees, and no vendor lock-in. You get full control over your software, with the freedom to scale or modify it as your business grows.

  * What post-deployment support does Devs Core offer?

We offer comprehensive maintenance and support services post-deployment to ensure the smooth operation of the software, including updates, bug fixes, and scalability support. 

Please check out our Maintenance Packages - https://devs-core.com/maintenance/

  * How do I get started with Devs Core?

Simply reach out through our contact form or schedule a consultation. We’ll listen to your vision, assess your needs, and prepare a tailored roadmap—from discovery to launch.

## FROM FIRST CALL TO DEPLOYMENT

# Website Development Process

### 1

## Discovery

  * Vision Brief 
  * Analysis 
  * Roadmap 



We begin every project by learning your startup’s goals, audience, and definition of success. Through a focused creative brief, we define your CTAs, messaging hierarchy, desired design tone, and key performance indicators — laying the foundation for a site that converts.

We help you choose the best-fit platform for your current needs and future growth — WordPress, Webflow, or a fully custom stack. Each solution comes with pros and trade-offs, and we guide you through the right decision for your team.

We map out the sitemap, content structure, and page hierarchy — prioritizing the user journey, SEO needs, and strategic entry points. This ensures your website communicates the right message to the right people, in the right order.

### 1

## Discovery

Vision Brief

We begin every project by learning your startup’s goals, audience, and definition of success. Through a focused creative brief, we define your CTAs, messaging hierarchy, desired design tone, and key performance indicators — laying the foundation for a site that converts.

Analysis

We help you choose the best-fit platform for your current needs and future growth — WordPress, Webflow, or a fully custom stack. Each solution comes with pros and trade-offs, and we guide you through the right decision for your team.

Roadmap

We map out the sitemap, content structure, and page hierarchy — prioritizing the user journey, SEO needs, and strategic entry points. This ensures your website communicates the right message to the right people, in the right order.

### 2

## UI / UX Design

  * Wireframing 
  * Visual Design 
  * Prototyping 



We create wireframes for key pages to define layout, flow, and content placement. These are designed with clarity, usability, and mobile-first logic — before any design elements are added.

Need help with look and feel? Our design team crafts pixel-perfect mockups based on your brand, target audience, and competitor landscape — ensuring visual consistency across devices and browsers.

For complex websites or client signoff, we build interactive prototypes to simulate navigation, hover states, mobile responsiveness, and transition effects. This gives you a clear feel of the end product before development begins.

### 3

## Development

  * Frontend 
  * Backend 
  * Optimization 



We build responsive, accessible frontends using your chosen tech — Webflow, WordPress (custom theme), or custom HTML/CSS/JS. Every line of code is optimized for speed, clarity, and SEO.

Whether it's WordPress with ACF or Webflow's CMS, we configure a structure that makes content updates simple for your non-technical team — all while keeping the codebase clean and future-ready.

Page speed, lazy loading, code minification, mobile responsiveness, and Core Web Vitals — we optimize every detail to ensure your website ranks well and loads fast across all devices.

### 4

## Test & Launch

  * Cross Browser 
  * SEO 
  * Launch 



We test the site across Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge, and all major mobile devices — ensuring your layout, fonts, animations, and buttons look perfect everywhere.

From structured headers and meta tags to alt texts and ARIA labels — we optimize your website to meet SEO best practices and accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.1 guidelines.

Once approved, we handle everything from server deployment to DNS updates and performance monitoring — ensuring a smooth, secure go-live with no downtime.

## FROM FIRST CALL TO DEPLOYMENT

# App Development Process

### 1

## Discovery

  * Product Brief 
  * Strategy 
  * Roadmap 



Every great app starts with a clear vision. We begin with a custom product brief to align on your goals, user personas, required features, integration needs, and how your mobile app fits into your overall business strategy.

Whether you're building iOS, Android, or both — we help you decide between native (Swift/Kotlin) or cross-platform (Flutter) approaches based on your speed, budget, and scalability needs.

After mapping your MVP and long-term features, we structure the app into agile sprints with milestones. We plan for launch and beyond — so your app is always ready to grow.

### 1

## Discovery

Product Brief

Every great app starts with a clear vision. We begin with a custom product brief to align on your goals, user personas, required features, integration needs, and how your mobile app fits into your overall business strategy.

Strategy

Whether you're building iOS, Android, or both — we help you decide between native (Swift/Kotlin) or cross-platform (Flutter) approaches based on your speed, budget, and scalability needs.

Roadmap

After mapping your MVP and long-term features, we structure the app into agile sprints with milestones. We plan for launch and beyond — so your app is always ready to grow.

### 2

## UX & UI Design

  * User Flow 
  * Wireframes 
  * Prototyping 



We define how users will move through the app — onboarding, navigation, actions — based on your target audience and desired outcomes. Every tap is intentional.

We create low-fidelity wireframes and high-fidelity mockups to visualize each screen, interaction, and edge case. Our designs are responsive, intuitive, and conversion-driven.

Before development, we build clickable prototypes to simulate the real app. This lets you test the experience, give feedback, and align your team early.

### 2

## UX & UI Design

User Flow

We define how users will move through the app — onboarding, navigation, actions — based on your target audience and desired outcomes. Every tap is intentional.

Wireframes

We create low-fidelity wireframes and high-fidelity mockups to visualize each screen, interaction, and edge case. Our designs are responsive, intuitive, and conversion-driven.

Prototyping

Before development, we build clickable prototypes to simulate the real app. This lets you test the experience, give feedback, and align your team early.

### 3

## Development

  * Frontend 
  * Backend 
  * Sprints 



Our mobile engineers code using Flutter, Swift, or Kotlin — delivering fast, responsive, and scalable mobile interfaces that match your designs pixel-for-pixel.

We connect your app to any backend system — custom-built or existing — using secure, RESTful APIs or Firebase. Real-time data syncing, user management, analytics, and more.

#### 

Features are developed in weekly sprints, with demos for each milestone. You get visibility into every stage — with full flexibility to adjust as needed.

### 3

## Development

Frontend

Our mobile engineers code using Flutter, Swift, or Kotlin — delivering fast, responsive, and scalable mobile interfaces that match your designs pixel-for-pixel.

Backend

We connect your app to any backend system — custom-built or existing — using secure, RESTful APIs or Firebase. Real-time data syncing, user management, analytics, and more.

Sprints

Features are developed in weekly sprints, with demos for each milestone. You get visibility into every stage — with full flexibility to adjust as needed.

### 4

## Test & Launch

  * QA & Testing 
  * Security 
  * Deployment 



We test your app on multiple screen sizes, OS versions, and devices — iOS and Android — to ensure consistent performance, speed, and UX.

From load times to user authentication, we stress-test and secure your app to make sure it’s ready for real-world use. No crashes. No data leaks.

We handle everything from app store submissions to metadata, screenshots, and launch strategy. You get a published app — without the publishing headache.

### 4

## Test & Launch

QA & Testing

We test your app on multiple screen sizes, OS versions, and devices — iOS and Android — to ensure consistent performance, speed, and UX.

Security

From load times to user authentication, we stress-test and secure your app to make sure it’s ready for real-world use. No crashes. No data leaks.

Deployment

We handle everything from app store submissions to metadata, screenshots, and launch strategy. You get a published app — without the publishing headache.

### 5

## Maintenance

  * Maintenance 
  * Analytics 
  * Scalability 



We stay onboard post-launch with bug fixes, OS compatibility updates, and version rollouts — so your app keeps up with your users.

We integrate app analytics so you can track installs, retention, drop-offs, and engagement. You’ll know exactly what’s working (and what needs fixing).

As your user base grows, so does your app’s complexity. We help you plan for scaling — from performance optimization to multi-platform support.

# FAQ?

# Most Asked Questions About Us

  * What makes Devs Core different from other software development companies?

Devs Core stands out due to our commitment to sustainable, tailor-made software solutions, 100% source code handover, punctuality in meeting deadlines, and strong partnerships with tech giants like Google, Microsoft, AWS, and Nvidia.

  * How does Devs Core ensure the sustainability of its software solutions?

We focus on building adaptable, efficient, and future-proof software that grows with your business, leveraging the latest technologies and proper documentations to ensure longevity and sustainability.

  * Can Devs Core handle the entire software development lifecycle?

Yes, we manage the full lifecycle of software development, from initial understanding and planning through development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.

  * What industries does Devs Core specialize in?

We cater to a wide range of industries, including E-Commerce, Institution, Recycling, Human Resources, Finance, Healthcare, Real Estate, AI integrations, IoT, and FinTech.

  * What are the benefits of custom software for startups?

Custom software gives startups complete flexibility to build tools that match their exact workflows. Unlike off-the-shelf platforms, it scales with your growth, integrates with your systems, and eliminates licensing restrictions. It also ensures long-term cost-efficiency and competitive advantage.

  * Does Devs Core offer custom software solutions for startups and small businesses?

Absolutely, we provide custom software solutions tailored to the unique needs of startups and small businesses, helping them scale and automate their operations effectively. However, we prefer working with companies that has been in the business for at least 3 years.

  * How does Devs Core ensure the quality and reliability of its software products?

Our quality assurance process involves rigorous testing, adherence to best practices, and leveraging our partnerships with global tech giants to ensure the highest standards of quality and reliability.

  * Can you integrate AI/LLMs into existing platforms?

Yes. We specialize in embedding AI and LLM-based tools into your current applications. Whether it's automating customer support, personalizing user journeys, or enabling intelligent data processing, we ensure smooth, secure integration with your existing stack.

  * What does 100% source code ownership mean?

It means you fully own all the code we write for your project—no hidden dependencies, no recurring fees, and no vendor lock-in. You get full control over your software, with the freedom to scale or modify it as your business grows.

  * What post-deployment support does Devs Core offer?

We offer comprehensive maintenance and support services post-deployment to ensure the smooth operation of the software, including updates, bug fixes, and scalability support. 

Please check out our Maintenance Packages - https://devs-core.com/maintenance/

  * How do I get started with Devs Core?

Simply reach out through our contact form or schedule a consultation. We’ll listen to your vision, assess your needs, and prepare a tailored roadmap—from discovery to launch.

## FROM FIRST CALL TO DEPLOYMENT

# Software Development Process

### 1

## Discovery

  * Vision Brief 
  * Analysis 
  * Roadmap 



Before a single line of code is written, we invite you to complete a tailored Vision Brief. This includes questions around your product goals, operational needs, growth trajectory, and how you define success. It’s the foundation for software that’s not just functional — but transformative.

We dive into your current tech stack, team structure, and market position. We analyze any existing systems, identify gaps, and define how custom software can accelerate your operations — using real-world startup experience and AI opportunities as our guide.

After aligning on objectives and scope, we craft a modular, scalable development roadmap. This includes clear milestones, sprint schedules, and MVP vs. long-term feature planning. Built for velocity, visibility, and adaptability — because startups don’t have time to waste.

### 1

## Discovery

Vision Brief

Before a single line of code is written, we invite you to complete a tailored Vision Brief. This includes questions around your product goals, operational needs, growth trajectory, and how you define success. It’s the foundation for software that’s not just functional — but transformative.

Analysis

We dive into your current tech stack, team structure, and market position. We analyze any existing systems, identify gaps, and define how custom software can accelerate your operations — using real-world startup experience and AI opportunities as our guide.

Roadmap

After aligning on objectives and scope, we craft a modular, scalable development roadmap. This includes clear milestones, sprint schedules, and MVP vs. long-term feature planning. Built for velocity, visibility, and adaptability — because startups don’t have time to waste.

### 2

## Architecture & Design

  * Architecture 
  * Schema 
  * UX Planning 
  * UI Design 



Our engineering team defines the core backend architecture that will drive your product. We prioritize clean, scalable, cloud-native structures — whether it’s a CRM, dashboard, member portal, or internal tool — with security and performance built-in.

We map out your data relationships, define entity structures, and plan API endpoints to ensure smooth integration, reporting, and automation. Designed to flex as your startup grows.

Before development, we wireframe the key flows: admin interfaces, onboarding journeys, dashboards, and more. This ensures your software feels intuitive — not like a clunky internal tool.

If you need UI/UX design, our in-house designers build sleek, modern interfaces to match your brand and user expectations — with responsiveness, accessibility, and conversion in mind.

### 2

## Architecture & Design

Architecture

Our engineering team defines the core backend architecture that will drive your product. We prioritize clean, scalable, cloud-native structures — whether it’s a CRM, dashboard, member portal, or internal tool — with security and performance built-in.

Schema

We map out your data relationships, define entity structures, and plan API endpoints to ensure smooth integration, reporting, and automation. Designed to flex as your startup grows.

UX Planning

Before development, we wireframe the key flows: admin interfaces, onboarding journeys, dashboards, and more. This ensures your software feels intuitive — not like a clunky internal tool.

UI Design 

If you need UI/UX design, our in-house designers build sleek, modern interfaces to match your brand and user expectations — with responsiveness, accessibility, and conversion in mind.

### 3

## Development

  * Coding 
  * Integration 
  * Reviews 



Our developers bring your custom software to life using modern frameworks like Django, Node.js, React, NextJS, PostgreSQL, Superbase, and Firebase. From frontend to backend, we code with startup-grade speed and enterprise-level structure.

Need GPT-powered workflows, predictive logic, or chatbot features? We integrate AI into your software where it adds real value — using LLMs, prompt APIs, or custom models that scale with you.

Transparency matters. You’ll get access to staging links, weekly reviews, and sprint demos. We adapt quickly based on feedback and ensure each phase is aligned with your evolving roadmap.

### 3

## Development

Coding

Our developers bring your custom software to life using modern frameworks like Django, Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, and Firebase. From frontend to backend, we code with startup-grade speed and enterprise-level structure.

Integration

Need GPT-powered workflows, predictive logic, or chatbot features? We integrate AI into your software where it adds real value — using LLMs, prompt APIs, or custom models that scale with you.

Reviews

Transparency matters. You’ll get access to staging links, weekly reviews, and sprint demos. We adapt quickly based on feedback and ensure each phase is aligned with your evolving roadmap.

### 4

## Test & Launch

  * QA & Testing 
  * Security 
  * Deployment 



Before launch, we run the software through functional testing, performance benchmarks, role-based access scenarios, and integration tests. We simulate real usage — so you don’t hit surprises post-deployment.

We apply modern security practices including encrypted tokens, permission validation, API hardening, and data audit logging. If your industry demands compliance, we build with that in mind from day one.

We handle cloud deployment, environment configuration, CI/CD setup, and post-launch monitoring. Whether it's AWS, Azure, GCP or DigitalOcean — we get your custom software running fast, securely, and under your full control.

### 4

QA & Testing

# FAQ?

# Most Asked Questions About Us

  * What makes Devs Core different from other software development companies?

Devs Core stands out due to our commitment to sustainable, tailor-made software solutions, 100% source code handover, punctuality in meeting deadlines, and strong partnerships with tech giants like Google, Microsoft, AWS, and Nvidia.

  * How does Devs Core ensure the sustainability of its software solutions?

We focus on building adaptable, efficient, and future-proof software that grows with your business, leveraging the latest technologies and proper documentations to ensure longevity and sustainability.

  * Can Devs Core handle the entire software development lifecycle?

Yes, we manage the full lifecycle of software development, from initial understanding and planning through development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.

  * What industries does Devs Core specialize in?

We cater to a wide range of industries, including E-Commerce, Institution, Recycling, Human Resources, Finance, Healthcare, Real Estate, AI integrations, IoT, and FinTech.

  * What are the benefits of custom software for startups?

Custom software gives startups complete flexibility to build tools that match their exact workflows. Unlike off-the-shelf platforms, it scales with your growth, integrates with your systems, and eliminates licensing restrictions. It also ensures long-term cost-efficiency and competitive advantage.

  * Does Devs Core offer custom software solutions for startups and small businesses?

Absolutely, we provide custom software solutions tailored to the unique needs of startups and small businesses, helping them scale and automate their operations effectively. However, we prefer working with companies that has been in the business for at least 3 years.

  * How does Devs Core ensure the quality and reliability of its software products?

Our quality assurance process involves rigorous testing, adherence to best practices, and leveraging our partnerships with global tech giants to ensure the highest standards of quality and reliability.

  * Can you integrate AI/LLMs into existing platforms?

Yes. We specialize in embedding AI and LLM-based tools into your current applications. Whether it's automating customer support, personalizing user journeys, or enabling intelligent data processing, we ensure smooth, secure integration with your existing stack.

  * What does 100% source code ownership mean?

It means you fully own all the code we write for your project—no hidden dependencies, no recurring fees, and no vendor lock-in. You get full control over your software, with the freedom to scale or modify it as your business grows.

  * What post-deployment support does Devs Core offer?

We offer comprehensive maintenance and support services post-deployment to ensure the smooth operation of the software, including updates, bug fixes, and scalability support. 

Please check out our Maintenance Packages - https://devs-core.com/maintenance/

  * How do I get started with Devs Core?

Simply reach out through our contact form or schedule a consultation. We’ll listen to your vision, assess your needs, and prepare a tailored roadmap—from discovery to launch.

## SOFTWARE COST TIME ESTIMATOR

## Estimate Your Software Cost & Time Using FPA

Now using ChatGPT, you can easily calculate your software cost & time

[Estimator 🧑‍💻](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-673d963797d0819185b27310d61d09ea-software-cost-time-estimator)

## How It Works

This is a simple GPT made with ChatGPT so that it can help you understand the estimated cost & time required for your software development. This is a generic GPT and only gives you an estimate to give an idea of the market. 

  * __ Start by explaining your user stories page by page. Explain all the actions the user can take in each page. Be as detailed as possible. 
  * __ The GPT will follow FPA method used at Devs Core to calculate your project's FPA. 
  * __ It will ask you several questions to understand your preferences regarding the development. 
  * __ At the end it will give you the overall cost & time required for your project. It will show you the units. You can also ask it to use different unit if you want. 



## How It Works

This is a simple GPT made with ChatGPT so that it can help you understand the estimated cost & time required for your software development. This is a generic GPT and only gives you an estimate to give an idea of the market. 

  * __ Start by explaining your user stories page by page. Explain all the actions the user can take in each page. Be as detailed as possible. 
  * __ The GPT will follow FPA method used at Devs Core to calculate your project's FPA. 
  * __ It will ask you several questions to understand your preferences regarding the development. 
  * __ At the end it will give you the overall cost & time required for your project. It will show you the units. You can also ask it to use different unit if you want. 



# FAQ?

# Most Asked Questions

  * How to calculate my software project cost & time?

Software cost time estimator can help you get your estimates instantly. You don't need any human interaction or won't have to wait for this.

  * What is Function Point Analysis (FPA), and why does it use it?

FPA is a standardized method for estimating software development efforts by assessing functional requirements.

  * Can it estimate costs for responsive designs and additional features?

Yes, it calculates responsive design FPAs separately and can adjust estimates for additional requirements shared by you.

  * How do team members affect the project cost and timeline?

Senior and mid-level professionals have different dollar-per-FPA and time-per-FPA rates, which impact both the cost and duration of the project.

  * What is included in it's project estimation summary?

It provides a detailed breakdown of UI FPA, development FPA (frontend and backend), and associated costs and time required for each phase.

  * Does it account for project management costs?

Yes, It includes project management costs based on a fixed rate per hour, though PM time does not affect the project’s overall timeline.

  * Can I revise my software requirements after an estimate is provided?

Absolutely. If requirements change, It re-evaluates the FPA points and adjust the estimations accordingly.

  * How does it ensure accuracy in it's estimates?

It follows a structured process based on the FPA method used at Devs Core, cross-referencing complexity, role seniority, and industry standards to deliver precise estimation.

However, this is not the exact cost & time. To get that, you can contact Devs Core or the software team who will build the project.

  * What happens if the scope of the project changes during development?

Scope changes require re-calculation of FPA points, which may adjust both the cost and time estimates.

# FAQ?

# Most Asked Questions by Institutions' Admins

  * What makes Devs Core’s E-commerce website solutions unique?

Devs Core offers sustainable, tailor-made software that perfectly fits your business needs. With 100% source code handover and a reputation for never missing deadlines, we provide reliable and high-quality services backed by partnerships with tech giants like Google, Microsoft, and AWS.

  * How does Devs Core integrate payment gateways into E-commerce websites?

Our team seamlessly integrates secure and reliable payment gateways into your E-commerce website, ensuring a smooth and secure transaction process for your customers. We support multiple payment methods, including credit cards, digital wallets, and bank transfers.

  * Can Devs Core help manage my inventory effectively?

Yes, our inventory management solutions are designed to streamline your operations, reduce manual errors, and provide real-time inventory tracking. This helps you maintain optimal stock levels, avoid overstocking or stockouts, and improve overall efficiency.

  * What kind of analytics and reporting does Devs Core offer for E-commerce businesses?

We provide comprehensive analytics and reporting tools that offer insights into customer behavior, sales performance, and marketing effectiveness. Our solutions help you make data-driven decisions to enhance your business growth and profitability.

  * How does Devs Core ensure the sustainability of its software solutions?

We focus on building software that stands the test of time, emphasizing sustainability and longevity. Our solutions are designed to be scalable, adaptable, and efficient, ensuring they meet your evolving business needs without requiring frequent overhauls.

  * What support does Devs Core offer post-launch of an E-commerce website?

Our dedicated support team offers continuous maintenance and technical support to ensure your E-commerce website runs smoothly. We provide regular updates, security patches, and performance optimizations to keep your site at its best.

  * How quickly can Devs Core deliver an E-commerce website?

We pride ourselves on our punctuality and commitment to deadlines. The timeline for delivering an E-commerce website depends on the project’s complexity, but usually it takes around 2-3 months starting from design to deployment.

  * What is included in the source code handover from Devs Core?

Yes, we will build the portal to scale and efficiently manage large databases of members or students, making it ideal for institutions and organizations with 10k+ members or students.

  * How does Devs Core ensure the security of my E-commerce website?

We implement robust security measures, including SSL encryption, secure payment gateways, regular security audits, and compliance with industry standards, to protect your website and customer data from potential threats.

  * What industries and business sizes does Devs Core cater to with its E-commerce solutions?

Devs Core caters to a wide range of industries and business sizes, from startups to large enterprises. Our solutions are customized to meet the unique needs and challenges of your specific industry, ensuring optimal performance and growth.

# FAQ?

# Most Asked Questions From Industries

  * Can Devs Core integrate payment gateways into our existing e-commerce platform?

Yes, we specialize in integrating a wide range of payment gateways into existing e-commerce platforms, enhancing your online store's functionality and user experience.

  * How can Devs Core's software solutions support member institutions in adopting member management software?

We build fully tailor-made solutions which fits within your institution's operational methods with features like student/member management, event scheduling, and journal publication platforms.

  * Does Devs Core offer solutions for waste management and recycling industries?

Absolutely, we provide comprehensive waste management and recycling solutions, including inventory and materials tracking, eco-coins & rewarding platforms with analytics, and compliance and regulatory management software.

  * What HR solutions does Devs Core provide for managing a remote workforce?

We offer a range of Human Resource Management Systems (HRMS) solutions tailored for remote workforce management, including payroll management, time and attendance tracking, and talent acquisition and applicant tracking systems.

  * Can Devs Core help financial institutions with data analytics and financial management software?

Yes, we build financial management software and data analytics platforms which are designed to meet the complex needs of the finance sector, providing robust tools for data analysis, reporting, and financial oversight.

  * How does Devs Core address the software needs of the healthcare industry?

We offer a suite of healthcare software solutions, including Electronic Health Records (EHR), medical billing, pharmacy management, and patient engagement systems, all designed to enhance the efficiency and quality of healthcare services.

  * Can Devs Core develop property management software for the real estate industry?

Our property management solutions for the real estate industry include features like virtual tours, property marketing tools, real estate valuation, and analytics and reporting to streamline operations and enhance property management.

  * How can Devs Core's IoT solutions benefit our business?

Our IoT solutions encompass device management, data analytics, and visualization, as well as connectivity protocols and database management, tailored to streamline operations and enhance data-driven decision-making.

  * What FinTech solutions does Devs Core offer for modern banking needs?

We specialize in FinTech solutions such as currency exchange platforms, neo-banking systems, bank transfers using bank APIs, AML integration, and KYC processes to meet the evolving needs of the financial industry.

  * How does Devs Core approach ongoing software maintenance and updates for its clients' applications?

Devs Core adopts a proactive approach to software maintenance, ensuring that your applications remain efficient, secure, and up-to-date. To check our Maintenance Packages please visit: https://devs-core.com/maintenance/
